Agents, Everywhere: Beyond The Chatbot — Global Hackathon

A global hackathon with OpenAI

On Saturday, September 12, AI Tinkerers cities around the world are joining one shared build day.

Build an agent for a place people already work, talk, and live, then make it meaningfully more useful because of that context.

Event details
  • Date: Saturday, September 12, 2026
  • Time: 10 a.m.–5 p.m. local time
  • Location: Shared upon acceptance
  • Format: Focused local build day, connected to one global challenge
  • Food and drinks: Pizza (vegetarian and non-vegetarian options) provided, with coffee, tea, and water.

The challenge

Most agents still wait inside a separate chat window. This build day starts from a different premise: the most useful agents will show up inside the tools, channels, devices, and environments where people already have work to do.

Build a working agent that belongs somewhere new.

Your project might live:
  • At work: Slack, Teams, email, documents, calendars, tickets, support, or live collaboration
  • In your pocket: messaging, mobile, notifications, and short asynchronous moments
  • On the web: browsers and software where an agent can research, navigate, transact, or take action
  • In the room: voice, vision, wearables, robotics, and other physical-world interfaces

These are examples, not separate tracks. Every team around the world enters the same global submission pool.

The day
Time What happens
10:00–10:30 Doors, check-in, and meeting potential teammates
10:30–11:00 Shared global opening and starter-kit walkthrough
11:00–11:15 Team formation (Suggested team size: 1-5)
11:15–15:30 Build session (Food and Drink will be provided around 12 PM)
15:00–15:30 Group Photo with Partners and Sponsors
15:30–16:00 Complete project submissions in the portal
16:00–16:30 Local show-and-tell (Support Team Hong Kong) (2 Minutes per Team; after submitting)
16:30–17:00 Local Prize Ceremony and wrap

Local demos are for sharing work and learning from the room. There is no formal local judging. However, there will be special “Support Team Hong Kong” segment, where prizes from local partners and supporters will be given builders to keep energy high and cheer for Team Hong Kong, and wish the teams the best on the global stage!

Your build stack

OpenAI and the event partners will provide shared starter materials, technical resources, and builder credits/offers where available. We will share the final starter repo and access details ahead of the event.

You do not need to use every tool in the stack. Choose the resources that make your idea better and make the technical choices that fit the project.

More starter materials, technical resources, sponsor offers, and event details will be added to this page as they are finalized.

What every team submits

Before the event ends, every team submits:
  1. Title — a clear name for the project
  2. Written description — what you built, who it is for, and why the context matters
  3. Public GitHub repository — working code that can be reviewed and learned from
  4. Two-minute video — a concise demo of the project in action
  5. Social post — a public post about the project that tags the event sponsors

Build something that can be shown. A sharp, working demo beats a broad concept.

Global review and prizes

Every eligible project from every participating city goes into one global review process. The final judging rubric, prize categories, and award details will be shared with builders before the event.

Global Prizes

One global competition, with prizes for the top builds from across all participating cities and the virtual edition.

First Place

  • $10,000 in OpenAI credits for the winning team
  • A Mac mini for every team member
  • $1,000 in Exa credits for the winning team
  • Exa swag

Second Place

  • $5,000 in OpenAI credits for the winning team
  • A pair of Ray-Ban Meta glasses for every team member
  • $500 in Exa credits for the winning team
  • Exa swag

Third Place

  • $2,500 in OpenAI credits for the winning team
  • A LOOI Robot for every team member
  • $250 in Exa credits for the winning team
  • Exa swag

Best Use of Ambiguous AI

  • One NVIDIA DGX Spark for the winning team

Best Use of CopilotKit

  • A pair of purple AirPods Max for every team member

Who should come

This is a builders-only AI Tinkerers event, and attendance is by application only. It is for engineers, technical founders, researchers, and designers who build and are ready to spend the day shipping a working prototype. Come with a team, come solo, or find collaborators at the event. Apply to join us. Space is limited in each city.

Global Sponsors

OpenAI

OpenAI is the headline partner for this global hackathon, supporting the builders pushing agents beyond the chatbox and into the places people already work, talk, and live.

CopilotKit

CopilotKit is the open-source framework for building in-app AI copilots and agentic interfaces. Its tools help developers bring agents into the products people already use.

OpenRouter

OpenRouter gives developers a unified API for working with leading AI models. Builders can use it to explore the right models for their projects and ship quickly.

Many more global partners will be joining the event and added to this page soon.

Developer Infrastructure Partners

Exa

Exa builds search infrastructure for AI applications. Its search engine and APIs help developers and agents find, retrieve, and synthesize high-quality web content through natural-language queries.

Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open-source background jobs framework for building reliable workflows in plain async code. It provides infrastructure for long-running tasks and AI workloads, including queuing, retries, elastic scaling, and real-time monitoring.

Auth0

Auth0 is an identity platform for developers, providing authentication and authorization infrastructure for web, mobile, and AI applications. Its SDKs and APIs help teams add secure login, access control, and identity workflows without building them from scratch.

Mozilla

Mozilla.ai builds open-source AI tools and infrastructure designed to make it easier for developers to create trustworthy, transparent, and controllable AI applications.

Ambiguous AI

Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment. Teams of up to five can use all 17 apps for free, and agents can get started through CLI or MCP in under a minute.

Hong Kong Sponsors and Partners

Organizers

Event organizer

Executive Director @ AI Tinkerers

This event is generously made possible by these local partners:

Venue Partner

Wholly owned by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) Government, Cyberport is Hong Kong’s digital tech hub and AI accelerator, with a vision to empower industry digitalisation and intelligent transformation, to promote the digital economy and AI development, and to foster Hong Kong to be an international AI, innovation and technology (I&T) hub. Cyberport gathers over 2,400 companies, including 29 listed companies and 10 unicorns.

Production Partner

Prompt in Progress is an AI ecosystem builder uniting builders, creators, and innovators across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area. Born from the driving force behind AI Tinkerers Hong Kong, we evolved from a technical meetup into a broader ecosystem that bridges AI knowledge across all audiences.

Hardware & Food and Beverage Partner

AMD is the high performance and adaptive computing leader, powering the products and services that help solve the world’s most important challenges. Our technologies advance the future of the data center, embedded, gaming and PC markets. Everything you need to build AI on AMD - complimentary cloud credits, premium AI training, expert support, and exclusive developer resources. The AMD AI Developer Program program is free to join and helps you build, optimize, and scale AI on AMD hardware.

Impact Partner

The One Earth Alliance is a collaborative platform that unites prominent family offices, investors, corporations, philanthropists, governments, and academic institutions to accelerate sustainable impact across Asia.

AI Album and Photography Partner

GUMP specializes in transforming photo data into delightful experiences through AI. Our AI-Powered Face Recognition and photo gallery streamline photo management for event organizers, making significant moments easily accessible. Proudly working with industry leaders like NVIDIA, HSBC, and Oracle, and supporting major summits globally.

Videography Partner

Back to support the community after helping us capture footage in our inauguration in 2024 December, this OG will return in Agents, Everywhere: Beyond The Chatbot — Global Hackathon (Hong Kong).

Gaming & Productivity Partner

2000Fun is one of the leading gaming and e-sports retail brands in Hong Kong, having served local and overseas gamers since 2003. Known for its strong presence both online and offline, it offers a comprehensive range of gaming products, game top-up cards, and specialized e-sports equipment.

Luminkey sparked from a common frustration: top performance often meant sacrificing style, while stunning designs skimped on real technical depth. After years deep in the mechanical keyboard world at Createkeebs, the team decided to change that—crafting clean, minimalist keyboards with unyielding precision and innovation.

Technology Partner

A Swiss company focused on innovation and quality, Logitech designs products and experiences that have an everyday place in people's lives. Founded in 1981 in Lausanne, Switzerland, and quickly expanding to Silicon Valley, Logitech connects people through innovative computer peripherals.

Strategic Press Partner

EDigest is a finance brand and platform for more than 40 years in Hong Kong. They make investment, business and economic content as everyone's food for thought. And to empower readers with the business and financial understanding to pursue their lifestyle and dreams!

Community Partners
